correctness.rationale: A two-step orbit forces edge-sign reversal by pairing the zero-divergence sum of consecutive edge-sign vectors with the sum of their endpoint potentials; each nonzero edge contribution would be strictly positive. On K_{2,n}, hub post-update labels U,V are determined by the five leaf-band sizes and individual leaves are then independently drawn from exact integer intervals, yielding the complete multinomial sum. The zero-gap formula handles equal hubs separately. An edge bound rigorously restricts leaf labels to [-n-1,n+1] and hub gaps to [-2n-2,2n+2]. An interior/tied/exterior case proof yields the sharp 2n-2 hub-gap maximum for n>=3, and explicit constructions fill the range with a unique extreme. Fixed configurations are constant; general eventual period<=2 is supported by Long-Narayanan. Independent direct vertex iteration checked every state of the proven finite domain for n=1..5 (9,602,861 states), matching formula counts and every tested hub-gap population; exact formula checks extend through n=10. These finite checks are supporting evidence, not the proof for unbounded n.

value.rationale: The number of initially periodic charge configurations modulo integer translation is a natural recurrent-state invariant of synchronous diffusion. The two-hub complete bipartite family is the minimal non-star biclique family with genuinely coupled hub updates; prior clique, cycle and double-star formulas do not resolve its all-size census. The exact closed finite sum, gap-resolved counts and fully filled sharp support with unique signed extremes for every n>=3 provide structural information not implied by eventual-period theory.
